list.title: Ŵakuzenga & Mapulojekiti
list.hint: Ŵakuzenga ŵakunjira pa webusayiti ya ŵakuzenga kuti ŵazomerezge kutumizgika kwa mapulojekiti ghawo na kukhozgera kuti ŵalembeska.

detail.deactivateHint: Kuziŵizga vimanyikwiro waliyose uyo wakugwiliskira ntchito wakuzenga uyu kufuma nyengo yeneyiyo.
detail.resetPrompt: Password yiphya ya {{name}} (pafupifupi malembo 8). Ŵazamusayinirika kulikose.
detail.projectsHint: Ŵanyawo ŵakusankha kufuma ku mapulojekiti ghakugwira ntchito para ŵakulembeska munthu uyo ​​wakulongozga; referral yikuluta kwa wakuzenga uyu.

protection.globalDays_one: Kukhazikika kwa pa charu chose ( {{count}} zuŵa)
protection.globalDays_other: Kukhazikika kwa pa charu chose ( {{count}} mazuŵa)
protection.placeholder: Mazuŵa ghakuvikilira (ghambura kanthu = ghakumanyikwa pa charu chose)
protection.hint: Kuvikilira kwakuwerezgawerezga: mazuŵa 1-3650, panji kusiya kwambura kanthu kuti mugwiriskirenge ncito ivyo vikuŵikika pa caru cose kufuma ku Makonzekero. Kusintha kukugwira ntchito waka pa kulembeska kuphya - awo ŵalipo ŵakusunga nyengo yawo yakumalira.

matching.hint: Ivyo vikupangiska kuti kulembeska kuŵiri kuŵe kasitomala yumoza wa pulojekiti. Kusintha kukugwira ntchito pa macheke ghakuwerezgawerezga kufuma sono; chitetezo icho chilipo chikukhwaskika yayi.
